name: mpl-figure-demo
notes: The ADR-0029 declared figure: marks say what to draw from the row stream, and the PNG lands in the run's artifacts — what a chart shows is part of the run's hashed identity. Colors come from the pack's fixed categorical order (never cycled); a mark-level `color` would override for a project brand. Bespoke figures subclass FigureNode instead.

market.notes: one instrument's daily quotes — mid under-reacts to p_true, which the figure makes visible

figure.notes: two lines share one y axis (there is deliberately no twin-axis knob); rows plot in stream order
